title: Investment and crypto traps in practice
intro: Never trust platforms that guarantee returns. Decide what you would do in each moment from this module's lessons.

decisions.title: Call from BakuTrade Pro

artifact.name: BakuTrade Pro
body: Hello, I am Javid Alizada, your personal adviser at BakuTrade Pro. We guarantee thirty percent a month, with no risk.

options.label: Sounds good, what do I do?
I will check your licence in the Central Bank's list

decisions.explain: Check the licence yourself in the official list, not by their word.

decisions.title: bakutrade-pro.example.net
decisions.prompt: The balance has grown. Now try to withdraw. What do you do on this page?
decisions.explain: Trying to withdraw does no harm. See what they ask for on the next screen.

decisions.title: Call from BakuTrade Pro

artifact.name: BakuTrade Pro
body: Great! It takes only 250 manat to start. Tell me your card number and the code on the back, and I will open the account.

options.label: I read out my card details
I do not give card details by phone

decisions.explain: Never tell anyone your card number or the code on the back over the phone.

decisions.title: Withdrawal on hold
decisions.prompt: They want a tax before the withdrawal. What do you do?

artifact.title: Withdrawal on hold
body: A 15% income tax is required to withdraw: 1,870 AZN.
If the tax is not paid, funds will be frozen in 48 hours.

decisions.explain: Being asked to pay to withdraw shows the platform is fake.

decisions.title: Call from BakuTrade Pro

artifact.name: BakuTrade Pro
body: We have a European licence, I have just sent you the certificate. No need to check with the Central Bank.

options.label: If there is a certificate, fine
I will still check the official list

decisions.explain: An adviser who tries to stop you checking gives himself away.
